Rules.InvariantScript: "Click to view the How to Guide"

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
If(
    Or(
        IsBlank(StartDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate),
        IsBlank(EndDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate),
        StartDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate > EndDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate
    ),
    Notify("Please fill out dates correctly", NotificationType.Error),
    If(
        DateDiff(StartDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate, EndDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate) + 1 + Sum(Gallery_Hours.AllItems, Value(TextLabel_Days.Text)) > Value(varHourThreshold),
        Notify("The number of days you're adding is more than your available hours", NotificationType.Error),
        Select(AddRecord_Button)
    )
)

If(
    Or(
        IsBlank(StartDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate),
        IsBlank(EndDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate),
        StartDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate > EndDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate
    ),
    Notify("Please fill out dates correctly", NotificationType.Error),
    If(
        DateDiff(StartDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate, EndDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate) + 1 + Sum(Gallery_Hours.AllItems, Value(TextLabel_Days.Text)) > Value(varHourThreshold),
        Notify("The number of days you're adding is more than your available hours", NotificationType.Error),
        Select(AddRecord_Button)
    )
)

Rules.InvariantScript:
UpdateIf(
    FlightEntries,
    FlightID = ThisItem.FlightID,
    {
        DepartureDate: Gallery_Departure_Date.SelectedDate,
        ArrivalDate: Gallery_Arrival_Date.SelectedDate,
        DepartureLocation: TextInput_Departure_Location.Text,
        ArrivalLocation: TextInput_Arrival_Location.Text,
        Companion: TextInput_Companion.Text
    }
)

UpdateIf(
    FlightEntries,
    FlightID = ThisItem.FlightID,
    {
        DepartureDate: Gallery_Departure_Date.SelectedDate,
        ArrivalDate: Gallery_Arrival_Date.SelectedDate,
        DepartureLocation: TextInput_Departure_Location.Text,
        ArrivalLocation: TextInput_Arrival_Location.Text,
        Companion: TextInput_Companion.Text
    }
)

UpdateIf(
    FlightEntries,
    FlightID = ThisItem.FlightID,
    {
        DepartureDate: Gallery_Departure_Date.SelectedDate,
        ArrivalDate: Gallery_Arrival_Date.SelectedDate,
        DepartureLocation: TextInput_Departure_Location.Text,
        ArrivalLocation: TextInput_Arrival_Location.Text,
        Companion: TextInput_Companion.Text
    }
)

// Remove the current item from 'Hours Tracking (Hours)'
Remove(FlightEntries, ThisItem);

UpdateIf(
    FlightEntries,
    FlightID = ThisItem.FlightID,
    {
        DepartureDate: Gallery_Departure_Date.SelectedDate,
        ArrivalDate: Gallery_Arrival_Date.SelectedDate,
        DepartureLocation: TextInput_Departure_Location.Text,
        ArrivalLocation: TextInput_Arrival_Location.Text,
        Companion: TextInput_Companion.Text
    }
)

UpdateIf(
    FlightEntries,
    FlightID = ThisItem.FlightID,
    {
        DepartureDate: Gallery_Departure_Date.SelectedDate,
        ArrivalDate: Gallery_Arrival_Date.SelectedDate,
        DepartureLocation: TextInput_Departure_Location.Text,
        ArrivalLocation: TextInput_Arrival_Location.Text,
        Companion: TextInput_Companion.Text
    }
)
"We didn't find any data to show at this time"

If(
    Not(CountRows(colVacationsUpdates) > 0),
    And(
        StartDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate = EndDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate,
        !IsBlank(StartDatePicker_Date.SelectedDate)
    ),
    false
)
"You have pending changes to be saved"

If(
    CountRows(FlightEntries) < 4,
    Collect(
        FlightEntries,
        {
            FlightID: CountRows(FlightEntries) + 1,
            DepartureDate: Blank(),
            ArrivalDate: Blank(),
            DepartureLocation: "",
            ArrivalLocation: "",
            Companion: ""
        }
    )
)

SortByColumns(
    Filter(
    'Vacations Tracking (Days)',
    Employee = User().Email
    )
,
"EndDate",
SortOrder.Descending)

If(
    TextLabel_Days.Text = "0", RGBA(252, 124, 124, 1), // Red if days = 0
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1) // Transparent
)

If(
    TextLabel_TravelDays.Text = "0", RGBA(252, 124, 124, 1), // Red if days = 0
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1) // Transparent
)

If(
    ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_1 = "Approved", RGBA(108, 212, 136, 1), // Green
    ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_1 = "Rejected", RGBA(252, 124, 124, 1), // Red
    ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_1 = "Pending", RGBA(252, 250, 124, 1), // Yellow
    RGBA(0, 0, 0, 0) // Transparent
)

If(
    ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_2 = "Approved", RGBA(108, 212, 136, 1), // Green
    ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_2 = "Rejected", RGBA(252, 124, 124, 1), // Red
    ThisItem.ApprovalStatus_2 = "Pending", RGBA(252, 250, 124, 1), // Yellow
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1) // Transparent
)
